### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via DatasetMeasureSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageTabsProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-4.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ComponentPropsMap (symbol, a top-level const object))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3d49a97f5cd10d71844996b15deffcff5b4d831c` — the merge of head `2d054b8dde3650223524ce14794549189b82aac9` into base `e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3d49a97f5cd10d71844996b15deffcff5b4d831c && git checkout 3d49a97f5cd10d71844996b15deffcff5b4d831c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d 2d054b8dde3650223524ce14794549189b82aac9 && git checkout -B drift-repro e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d && git merge --no-ff 2d054b8dde3650223524ce14794549189b82aac9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e49aaec733d5cebd82a6b2e5521cdaae998b5b8d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2d054b8dde3650223524ce14794549189b82aac9`
Local-runs: none

Console pin hop #3 (card #15204, dispatch and claim 6125834452; the first `next` waits for it, ruling 6125978136). Read: the card body and the comments bearing on this hop, the PR body, its 20 files and its diff against `main` (merge base `df7a137923`; `main` has moved 4 commits since, all in `packages/organizations`, no file in common), objectui at `7578323a544e` and `9646e2ed2bf3` in a scratch clone (`git diff --quiet` per file, `git show` per anchor), the pin-round scripts and `.changeset/pre.json` on `main`, and the head's check-runs, read at 14:33Z and again at 15:02Z (the final read, below). The precedent hunted for is #22967's FAIL 6119955714: a "byte-identical" sentence on a file that changed.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) The pin and its gate.** `.objectui-sha` is exactly `7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21`; `9646e2ed2bf315a6ae99b2a1633bc7c7d162f7b9` is its ancestor (`merge-base --is-ancestor`), both on objectui `main`. The hop is 25 commits, all first-parent (linear), 288 paths; `a491b64a6` (objectui#12200) is among them, as are the eight the PR names. **Console Pin Gate on this head is `skipped`, by design, not by filter:** `ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job carries `github.event_name != 'pull_request' && != 'merge_group'` (the two-speed split, #22998), so it never runs on a PR and judges the pin on `main`'s push and hourly battery after merge. The developer's four local steps (client build, `build-console.sh`, `check:console-sha` "dist matches objectui@7578323a544e", `check:console-injection --require-stamp`) are the only pre-merge evidence, the same shape #23018 landed on. Right.

**(b) The SDUI artefacts.** `sdui.manifest.json` is not in the diff and is byte-identical to `main`; at the head it holds 107 components and its sha256 (`a799c55a…4db4`) equals `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`'s `sha256`, whose only moved fields are `objectuiSha` and `modulesRoot` (`.cache/objectui-7578323a544e/apps/console`); `check-sdui-manifest`'s staleness clause (record sha equals the pin) is satisfied. `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` moves `rev`, `revDate` (`2026-10-12T13:34:53+00:00`, which is `7578323a5`'s committer date) and `recordedAgainstPin` only; I recomputed the grammar region of objectui's `parse.ts` at the pin from the recorded delimiter to end of file: 214 lines, blob `0131f27cf86d…`, equal to the record; 25 diagnostic codes and the containment predicate are carried unchanged. objectui's `packages/sdui-parser/src` is byte-identical across the hop (`git diff --quiet` on the directory). **No parser port is owed.** Right.

**(c) The spec source edits.** A mechanical sweep of every changed line under `packages/spec/src` finds exactly one line that is neither a comment line nor a string-continuation line: the `FormField.span` describe in `view.zod.ts`, and inside it only the pin token (`9646e2ed2bf3` to `7578323a544e`) moves; `z.enum(['auto', 'full']).default('auto')` is unchanged. The six `migrations/entries/semantic/18.*` edits are inside `description` string literals (pin sha, corpus 8540 to 8600, the control counts). `functional-completeness.ts`, `component.zod.ts`, `action.zod.ts`, `dataset.zod.ts` and the three tests change comment text only. **No accepted shape, default, required flag, enum member or exported symbol moves.** `Clause-②: no` and `patch` on the spec changeset are right.

**(d) The citations, the #22967 class — hunted file by file, not sampled.**
- I scanned every docblock and `//` run in `packages/spec/src` at the head for the blanket sentence "every objectui file this record cites is byte-identical across the hop from `9646e2ed2`" (joined across wrapped comment lines): 32 blanket records plus 4 named-list records. For each, every objectui file name in the same docblock was resolved at `7578323a544e` and checked with `git diff --quiet 9646e2ed2bf3 7578323a544e -- path`. **Zero blanket records cover a changed file.** The one blanket record that names changed files is the `object-kanban` row cap (`component.zod.ts` 6167–6453), and its own sentence carves them out: "`ListView.tsx` and `ObjectView.tsx`, named below only as an earlier re-read's record … (`ListView.tsx` and app-shell's `ObjectView.tsx` changed on this hop)". Confirmed: `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` changed (+4/−3, objectui `fa778e67f` and `f38a42827`); `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` is byte-identical.
- `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: hop diff is +34/−79 with hunks at `:10`, `:12` (in place), `+:16` (the `ListEmptyState` import), `+1039–1042` (a four-line docblock), `:1044` in place (`useListViewTranslation` exported), and `5677` down. So lines 17–1037 shift by one and 1040–5676 by five; I diffed both shifted regions whole (old 17–1037 vs new 18–1038; old 1040–5676 vs new 1045–5681): **empty**. Every anchor the PR names reads the quoted text at both pins: `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING` 95→96, `resolveListMapConfig` 209→210, `resolveTimelineDateBinding` 695→696, `case 'kanban'` 3762→3767, `calendar` 3813→3818, `timeline` 3902→3907, `gantt` 3959→3964, `map` 4079→4084, `tree` 4120–4144→4125–4149 (the 25-line arm diffs empty; `labelField: treeCfg.labelField || 'name'` is at `:4145`).
- `core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: +39/−23; the only hunks above the reader add 1 + 10 = 11 lines (`classifyNavigationTarget` import and `NAVIGATION_TARGET_REFUSAL`), the next hunk starts at old `1648`. `composeSuccessMessage` is at `1498` and `1509`, and old 1498–1647 vs new 1509–1658 diffs empty. The `outcomeMessages` record in `action.zod.ts` re-points to `:1509`; the four action renderers are byte-identical (scan).
- `i18n/src/locales/{en,zh,de}.ts` changed (en +17/−9, zh and de 9/9); `calendar.configRequired` is textually identical at `en` 949→953, `zh` 725→726, `de` 705→706. `en.ts` carries exactly the five commits named (`7578323a5`, `fa778e67f`, `38bb37333`, `b2316074a`, `54159d329`).
- Quoted anchors: all 13 (the `ASSERTED_ANCHOR_FLOOR`) verify at the pin, including the two the PR says `--verify-anchors` caught in the dated map-config record of `view.zod.ts` (`ListView.tsx:210` first line `function resolveListMapConfig(…`; `ListView.tsx:96` first line `export const FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING = {`), and `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:2479` `case 'map':`, `objectql.zod.ts:2523` / `:1506`, `ObjectMap.tsx:449` / `:454`. No asserting citation names a sha other than the pin. The CI owner of this gate, `Type Check · source gates` (`check:objectui-pin-citations`), is green on the head.
- Out of population, stated so the next reader need not re-derive it: eight more anchored objectui files changed on the hop (`plugin-form/src/{ObjectForm,DrawerForm,ModalForm}.tsx`, `plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`, `fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `types/src/field-types.ts`, `types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`). Every record naming them is a dated `pin` record or carries no pin claim (none asserts `= 7578323a5`), which the gate deliberately excludes; no byte-identical sentence covers them.
- `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`: the two `span` rows' text equals the describe string character for character (after the generator's `\|` escaping), both rows are identical, and no old sha remains in the file. A regeneration, not a hand edit. Right.

**(e) The changesets and ADR-0087.** The hop adds 31 changesets across 23 of the 25 commits; 2 are release-nothing (`12204`, `12202`) and 2 commits carry none (`5039e8117`, `21fdeb34d`, both `ci:`), so "29 releasing of 31, 2 release-nothing, 2 no changeset" is exact. The highest declared level is `minor` (several `minor`, no `major`), which is the digest's rule for the console bump; the `Clause-②: no` line is hand-added (the digest emits none). The five breaking entries are breaking by annotation only, none `major`, no `!` subject. Each `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` line, judged against this tree at the head and objectui at the pin:
  1. objectui#12198, `console.breadcrumb.pages`: 0 occurrences in this repo outside changesets. Right.
  2. objectui#12163, the widget `component` envelope: `ui/dashboard.zod.ts:188–189` quarantines `component` and `data` (`QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS`), so no authored dashboard here can reach the envelope; the eight `*.dashboard.ts` files under `examples/` author neither key. objectui's own changeset carries a FROM/TO prescription, but it is objectui's consumer prescription for `@object-ui/types`; nothing in `sys_metadata` or any objectstack-authorable key moves, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite. Right.
  3. objectui#12190, `environment.addEnvironment` and test id `environment-add-upgrade`: 0 occurrences. Right.
  4. objectui#12156, `maxSize`: declared at `data/field.zod.ts:1376`; `FieldSchema` is a `strictObject` (aliases `maxFileSize` / `maxBytes` to `maxSize`), so `max_size`, `max_files`, `max_width`, `max_height` are refused; none is authored in `examples/` or `packages/` (the only `max_size` hit is `scripts/pr-labels.mjs`'s unrelated `xs_max_size`). Right.
  5. objectui#12187, the splash: the four retired keys have 0 occurrences; the two readers here, `examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts:110–111` (`BOOT_SPLASH_LINE = /Initializing application|Opening your console/i`, `[data-boot-splash]`) and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`'s boot-splash clause, already accept both lines and the marker. Right.
  The gate's mechanical refusal (a prescription in THIS changeset's body) does not fire: the console body carries the digest's truncated entry lines and no FROM/TO of its own; `Check Changeset` (runs `check-adr-0087-registration --base` and `check-changeset-no-major`) is green. **`not-required` is right for all five; no migration prescription is owed by this repository.**
  `Clause-②: no` for this repository: the line answers 「本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗」 for THIS diff. objectui's `38bb37333` declares `Clause-②: yes` for an additive `AppSwitcher` prop and three `@object-ui/i18n` keys — surfaces of objectui's packages, which this repo does not publish; `@objectstack/console` ships a built SPA, and the diff widens no objectstack accept set and adds no export (the sweep in (c)). The breaking-ness the hop carries is declared by the five `**BREAKING**` banners, which the ADR-0087 gate reads independently of the Clause line. `no` is right, as on #23018 and #22967.

**(f) The edited tests.** `api-methods-batch-conformance.test.ts` (+4/−1) changes the docblock inside the `SINGLE_RECORD_WRITE_ONLY` record; `action-outcome-messages.test.ts` (+6/−1) changes its header docblock (the `composeSuccessMessage` move); `component.test.ts` (+24/−6) changes six `//` describe headers. The sweep in (c) finds no non-comment line in any of the three. **No assertion is weakened.**

**(g) The browser check.** 15 options on #23018's 17 is exactly the two anchors removed. objectui#12200 (`a491b64a6`) filters `RegistryRefField` on `AUDIENCE_ANCHOR_POSITIONS` imported from `@objectstack/spec`; this tree exports it (`identity/position.zod.ts:166`, `index.ts:181`, `['everyone','guest']`), so the measured list is the code path, and the 201 on `POST /data/sys_user_position` shows the picker still writes. For objectui#12185: its seven source files under `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` are byte-identical across the hop (only `packages/app-shell/README.md` overlaps the 288 paths), so the walled re-run (tenant 403 on `PUT /meta/position`, no New / Save / Clone, the three reason test ids; operator auto-save 200) is confirmation of an unchanged surface under a changed shell — adequate. The harness is #23018's uncommitted local dependency and two env vars; none of the 20 files is under `examples/`. The top-bar identity claims match `38bb37333`'s commit record item by item. Adequate evidence.

**(h) No collateral.** 20 files: the pin, the two changesets, the regenerated `view.mdx`, the lockstep and manifest records, and the `packages/spec/src` re-measures. No `CHANGELOG.md`, nothing under `content/docs/releases/`, nothing under `examples/`, nothing outside the pin round's shape. Tier: no governed surface (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` green).

**Check-runs on `2d054b8dde36` at the final read (15:02Z, 41 runs, all completed):** no red and nothing pending. Green: `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, all six `Test Core` shards, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` job, `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and the three claim guards. Skipped by design, the only non-success conclusions: `Console Pin Gate` (above), the dogfood shards and `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Packed-tarball smoke`. At 14:33Z the same set had fourteen runs still in progress and `Test Core (3/6)` / `(4/6)` were the last two to finish.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/console-7578323a544e.md`, `@objectstack/console` **minor**: matches the hop's highest declared level (`minor`), as the digest derives it; the sentence census (29 / 2 / 2, five annotated-breaking, two `_(no changeset)_` rows naming `5039e8117` and `21fdeb34d`) reads true against the 25 commits. Right.
- `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-7578323a544e.md`, `@objectstack/spec` **patch**: what publishes is description text (the `span` describe and six migration `description` strings) and comments; no key, default, enum member or export moves. Each sentence in it (the three changed files, the moved line numbers, 288 paths / 25 commits, 8600 tracked files) is reproduced above. Right.
- `Clause-②: no` on both, and on the PR: right for this repository (e).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Console Pin Gate `skipped` on the PR: answered — the two-speed design (#22998); the full battery on `main` judges the pin after merge, as it did for #23018.
- No check-run is red or pending at the final read (15:02Z); the five skips are design skips, each named above.
- The developer's "every other record cites only byte-identical files" is a claim about asserting records; the eight changed files cited only by dated records are out of the gate's population by design and are named above so the exclusion is visible.
- objectui `38bb37333`'s `Clause-②: yes` vs this PR's `no`: answered — different published surfaces (e).
- `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors` cannot run in CI (no `../objectui`); the dev's 13-of-13 anchor verification is reproduced here against the scratch clone.
- The sweep's verdict comment the PR body promises (`dispatch-gates --ran`) is not on the PR thread at the time of this record; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts this record reads.
